modelId.title: Model Id
modelId.description: The Model ID to use for predictions (e.g., gemini-2.5-pro).

serviceAccountKey.title: Service Account Key
serviceAccountKey.description: The service account key to use as credentials for the Vertex AI client. You must encode this value in base64.

temperature.title: Temperature
temperature.description: Controls randomness in generation. Lower values make output more deterministic. Range 0.0 to 1.0.

maxOutputTokens.title: Max Output Tokens
maxOutputTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate in the response.

topP.title: Top P
topP.description: Nucleus sampling parameter. Considers tokens with top_p probability mass. Range 0.0 to 1.0.

topK.title: Top K
topK.description: Only sample from the top K options for each subsequent token.
